changed.title: Exact circuit cost on an affine basis of selectors and the sharp loss one gate below it
changed.statement:
∀ k m r : ℕ,
  let n := k+2*m+r
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let F := ZMod 2
  let legal := fun (width : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (width : ℕ) (u : Fin width → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin width => decide (u j = 1))
  let V := Fin n → F
  let S := Fin k → F
  let D := Fin m → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let base := 2*m+r
  ∀ (e : V ≃ₗ[F] S × (D × (D × Z))) (A : Fin m → S) (h : S → F),
    let word := fun (s : S) (i : Fin m) => dotProduct (A i) s
    let score := fun (C : Circ) (s : S) =>
      (∑ x : V, ∑ b : D, ∑ c : D, ∑ z : Z,
        let y := e.symm (s,(b,(c,z)))
        let v := dotProduct x y + h s + ∑ i, word s i * b i * c i
        if C.eval (bits n x ++ bits n y) = decide (v = 1) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) / 2^(n+base)
    let fits := fun (p : ℕ) (C : Circ) => legal (2*n) C ∧ cost C ≤ p
    ∀ (E : Finset S) (a : S), a ∈ E →
      let W := Submodule.span F (Set.image (fun s : S => s-a) (↑E : Set S))
      let d := Module.finrank F W
      let varying := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i =>
        ∃ s ∈ E, word s i ≠ word a i)).card
      let price := base+d+varying
      let isolate := fun (u : S) => ∃ (i : Fin m) (v : F),
        ∀ s ∈ E, (word s i ≠ v ↔ s = u)
      let feasible := fun (p : ℕ) (b : ℝ) =>
        ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Circ) (w : Fin N → ℝ),
          (∀ i, fits p (C i) ∧ 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
          ∀ s ∈ E, b ≤ ∑ i, w i * score (C i) s
      0 < d → E.card = d+1 →
        (∀ p : ℕ, (∃ C : Circ, fits p C ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, score C s = 1) ↔ price ≤ p) ∧
        (∀ μ : S → ℝ, (∀ s ∈ E, 0 ≤ μ s) →
          let option := fun (v : ℝ) => (∃ u ∈ E, v = μ u) ∨
            ∃ (i : Fin m) (b : F), (∃ u ∈ E, word u i ≠ word a i) ∧
              v = (∑ s ∈ E, if word s i ≠ b then μ s else 0) / 2
          let loss := fun (C : Circ) => ∑ s ∈ E, μ s * (1-score C s)
          ∃ v : ℝ, option v ∧ (∀ w : ℝ, option w → v ≤ w) ∧
            (∀ C : Circ, fits (price-1) C → v ≤ loss C) ∧
            ∃ C : Circ, fits (price-1) C ∧ loss C = v) ∧
        (∀ b : ℝ, feasible (price-1) b → b ≤ 1-1/(2*(E.card : ℝ))) ∧
        (feasible (price-1) (1-1/(2*(E.card : ℝ))) ↔ ∀ u ∈ E, isolate u)

changed.context: A flat missing a test loses its weight. The hull of the other basis points can omit it alone. A flat covering the basis pays its dimension and must leave a varying column. A cheaper perfect profile cannot exist by the dimension and column costs.

changed.title: Encoder gate budgets determine pointwise equality-parity savings in each open bias interval and at the first endpoint
changed.statement:
∀ (a r : Nat), 3 ≤ a → 0 < r →
  let q := 2^a
  let ρ : ℚ := 1 - 4 / (q : ℚ)
  let τ := fun (j : Nat) => ρ^j / (1+ρ^j)
  ∀ β : ℚ, τ (r+1) < β → (β < τ r ∨ (r = 1 ∧ β = τ r)) →
    ∃ K : Nat, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (m g : Nat), 0 < m →
      let n := a*m
      let W := Fin m → Fin a → Bool
      let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
      let legal := fun (C : Circ) =>
        (∀ i : Fin C.gates.length, ∀ v ∈ (C.gates.get i).inputs, v < n+i.val) ∧
        (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
          (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
      let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
        ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
      let works := fun (b : Nat) =>
        b ≤ n ∧ ∃ (z : Nat) (C : Fin z → Circ) (tap : Fin z → Fin (n-b) → Nat)
          (read : Fin z → (Fin (n-b) → Bool) → W → Bool),
          0 < z ∧ (∀ s, legal (C s) ∧ cost (C s) ≤ g ∧
            ∀ j, tap s j < n+(C s).gates.length) ∧
          ∀ x y : W,
            let truth := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i => x i = y i)).card % 2 == 1
            let hits := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin z)).filter (fun s =>
              read s (fun j => ((C s).wires ((List.ofFn x).flatMap (fun v => List.ofFn v))).getD
                (tap s j) false) y = truth)).card
            (1+β)*(z : ℚ) ≤ 2*(hits : ℚ)
      let scale := (1+min m g)^r
      (∀ b : Nat, works b → 2^b ≤ K*scale) ∧
        ∃ b : Nat, works b ∧ scale ≤ K*2^b

∀ (N g t d M p : ℕ), 0 < g → 2*g+1 < N → N < 2*t → t ≤ N → 0 < M →
  d ≤ p → p ≤ N →

  (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ g+1 → d ≤ r*(g+1-r) → p ≤ r*(g+1-r)) →
  let X := Fin N
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.output < N+N+C.size ∧
